name: shell-topbar-split-doc
description: Top navigation + a selecting list on the left, the document read on the right. The selection travels in the URL.
provenPattern: Shell matrix — chrome × body: 5 chromes × 4 bodies = 20, four eliminated (with no chrome a grid has no way out, a dense surface has no interaction, a split refutes itself) → 16 cells.

knowledge.purpose: The frame of a pile of records: select on the left, read on the right — and the selected record is shareable as a link
antiPatterns: Keeping the selection out of the URL — then the record cannot be shared and Back does not work
Turning the detail pane into a second menu — the detail is the answer
Using it with a single record — with nothing to choose this is not a split

mobileCollapse: The top bar collapses into a drawer; links are listed in one column. Two panes collapse to one: a list page, and selecting NAVIGATES to a detail page — the URL already carries the selection, so Back returns to the list.

placeholders.{{ITEMS}}: records of the split list: [{id, title, meta?, excerpt?, body?, entries?}]
placeholders.{{SEL}}: name of the URL parameter that carries the selection
placeholders.{{MAIN}}: main slot — the action area BELOW the detail (the composer in stream mode)
placeholders.{{LEGAL}}: copyright / legal line — PLAIN TEXT, one line (e.g. "© 2026 Acme Ltd."). The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. Leave it empty ("") for none
